records.title: Don't Settle Too Early: Self-Reflective Remasking for Diffusion Language Models
records.reason: Primary abstract reviewed at https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.23653. Self-reflective remasking focuses on diffusion language-model quality, not LLM serving efficiency.

records.title: Machine Translation in the Era of Large Language Models:A Survey of Historical and Emerging Problems
records.reason: Primary abstract reviewed at https://doi.org/10.3390/info16090723. Machine-translation survey, not an LLM inference optimization.

records.title: ReARTeR: Retrieval-Augmented Reasoning with Trustworthy Process Rewarding
records.reason: Primary abstract reviewed at https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.07861. ReARTeR improves RAG reasoning quality via post-training/test-time search; no inference-efficiency gain claimed.

records.title: Automated Program Refinement: Guide and Verify Code Large Language Model with Refinement Calculus
records.reason: Primary abstract reviewed at https://doi.org/10.1145/3704905. Automated program refinement focuses on correctness of generated code, not inference efficiency.

records.title: MoVE-KD: Knowledge Distillation for VLMs with Mixture of Visual Encoders
records.reason: This single-encoder distillation is for VLM visual encoders; no direct LLM-service inference latency/throughput is reported in checked body.
